title: BitLocker protection status per fixed drive letter (no key material)
source_interface: Shell.Application ExtendedProperty System.Volume.BitLockerProtection (non-elevated; status code only)

data.interpretation_source: Community-documented mapping of the shell property; not an official Microsoft table. Raw 0 is ambiguous and does not by itself prove the volume is unencrypted. BootStatus meaning is undocumented.
